text:
michelle: Alert — seeing elevated GPU allocation timeouts in us-central2, fabric packet drops around 10:02 UTC. Some Dedicated pools failing to provision. I’m opening a bridge. Incident id INC-2123456789
oncall-bot: Bridge created: https://call.example/bridge/INC-2123456789 — page pinned
raj: joining bridge, checking NIC counters + flow telemetry
jess: how many customers affected? any enterprise Dedicated tenants impacted?
raj: preliminary: ~5 hosted clusters experiencing increased queue times, 2 Dedicated customers hitting provisioning failures. Fallbacks to smaller VMs succeeded for a few.
tao: can we reroute new provisioning requests to us-east1 / us-west1 temporary? what's cross-region cost hit?
raj: yes we can. plan: shift provisioning policy to prefer us-east1 for new jobs, keep existing pinned jobs unchanged. ETA to start shift 15m.
michelle: support please prepare a status page draft and a support template for affected customers. Keep wording: 'degraded provisioning' not 'outage' until confirmed.
support-bot: New incident INC-2123456789 created in Pager, severity P2
kate: I can draft status. Proposed text:
```
We are investigating elevated GPU provisioning times in us-central2 causing delays for some workloads. Engineers are routing new provisioning to alternate regions. We will post updates every 30 minutes. Affected customers may see slower job starts or provisioning errors.
```
michelle: good. add ETA: 'initial reroute starts in 15m, estimated stabilization within 60-90m, updates at :30 and :00'
jess: Capture list of impacted tenants so ACs can proactively reach out — raj can you share list in PM?
raj: will DM the list. Also flagging 2 Dedicated tenants for SLA support escalation.
michelle: SRE: what's root cause hypothesis?
raj: fabric interface on a subset of nodes experiencing microbursts causing packet drops on RDMA lanes — potentially driver/firmware regression after last rolling update. Investigating.
tao: rollback of recent driver rollout to subset of affected AZs possible? cost/time tradeoffs?
raj: rollback will require node restarts and will take ~30-45m per AZ. Preference for traffic shift to avoid evictions.
michelle: ops: run cost estimate for cross-region routing (egress + spot replacements) — we may offer credits if Dedicated SLA breached.
kate: drafting support template now — short message and FAQ bullet:
```
Hi — we're investigating provisioning delays in us-central2. We're routing new requests to other regions and expect stabilization in 1-1.5 hours. No immediate action required; contact support if you need pinned-region capacity.
```
support-bot: Suggested status page update ready: /status/incidents/INC-2123456789
raj: starting routing change now: updating policy docs, will monitor queue depths and token errors
michelle: please post first status update at :30 and ping sales/support for enterprise outreach
jess: FYI — finance asked to capture projected incremental infra cost for the incident for potential credits. tao to compute.
tao: estimate: cross-region egress and replacement instances ~ $6.2k per hour if we shift 70% traffic — rough numbers will refine.
michelle: good — hold on credits until we have final impact but pre-approve up to $25k for immediate mitigation
raj: routing change in progress — metrics show queue depth down 40% after policy flip
kate: posting status update now. Copy:
```
(12:30 UTC) We are investigating elevated GPU provisioning times in us-central2. Traffic for new provisioning is being routed to alternate regions. Engineers estimate stabilization within 60–90 minutes. We will post another update at 13:00 UTC.
```
michelle: support please send proactive messages to the two Dedicated customers with SLA notice and offer of short-term reserved nodes in other regions
support-bot: Message queued to tenant A and tenant B — support reps assigned: @jess, @kate
raj: continuing to monitor. kernel/fabric team looped in for driver analysis.
michelle: thanks all. next update 13:00 UTC unless status changes earlier
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2123456789 — last updated 12:35 UTC — severity: P2 — bridge open
raj: root cause candidate narrowed to firmware regression on NIC batch, looking at safe rollback plan if needed
tao: cost tracker updated in incident doc: https://docs.example/incidents/INC-2123456789/costs
kate: 13:00 update posted: queue depths back to ~10% over baseline, provisioning error rate down 65% — still monitoring
michelle: great. please keep support and sales looped if any Dedicated SLA looks like breach
raj: continuing analysis; will prepare post-incident RCA draft once stabilized
michelle: if we need to escalate to P1 we'll update channel — otherwise continue with P2 ops
kate: closing customer comms loop for now, will update if Dedicated customers need credits/action
jess: thanks team
